key.name: sidebar-position
key.description: The screen edge the sidebar is attached to.

key.name: sidebar-width
key.description: Width in pixels. At runtime it is also capped at half the work-area width.

key.name: background-opacity
key.description: Opacity of the sidebar background only; text stays fully opaque.

key.name: color-scheme
key.description: Follow the system style, or force light or dark.

key.name: sidebar-hidden
key.description: Whether the user has hidden the sidebar. Restored across sessions.

key.name: toggle-meeting-mode
key.summary: Turn Meeting mode on or off

key.name: focus-sidebar
key.summary: Move keyboard focus to the sidebar

key.name: morning-reminder-enabled
key.description: Whether to send a reminder for the morning practice.

key.name: morning-reminder-time
key.description: HH:MM, 24-hour local time. Values that are not valid HH:MM are treated as disabled.

key.name: evening-reminder-enabled
key.description: Whether to send a reminder for the evening reflection.

key.name: evening-reminder-time
key.description: HH:MM, 24-hour local time. Values that are not valid HH:MM are treated as disabled.
